name: Pran Taylor
source:
Likes: Worrying other people, art, pomegranates
Dislikes: Everything else (?)

Pran rarely draws attention to himself; he often won't even speak. But that doesn't make him more tolerable. He only sees the worst in others, actively chooses to be difficult because he thinks you deserve it, holds endless grudges, and is incredibly stubborn.

[From [url=https://gb-patch.tumblr.com/post/160243711416/we-made-some-shiny-new-character-bio-images-for]Tumblr[/url]]
